stage_2_story.text_en:
It was David's first long-haul flight — all the way from Tel Aviv to New York, with a layover in Paris. He was very excited. He was also very nervous.

At boarding, David discovered he had a window seat, which made him extremely happy. He immediately pressed his nose against the glass before the plane even moved. However, his happiness faded quickly when he tried to put his enormous suitcase into the overhead compartment. It did not fit. He pushed. He turned it sideways. He pushed again. A kind member of the cabin crew appeared with a professional smile and solved the problem in approximately three seconds.

Take-off was thrilling. David gripped his armrest and grinned like a child. An hour into the flight, the pilot announced turbulence. The plane shook. David gripped both armrests and his neighbour's arm. He apologized.

During the layover in Paris, David bought a croissant and felt very sophisticated.

Back on the second plane, he chatted happily with the cabin crew. When the landing finally came — smooth and gentle — David clapped. He was the only one who did. New York was waiting.

options: (d) The cabin crew showed a safety video

(d) He called his family from a phone booth

options: (a) He was disappointed by the rough landing
(b) He fell asleep and missed it
(c) He complained to the cabin crew
(d) He clapped, even though no one else did

stage_3_visual_situational.prompt: The pilot comes on the speaker and says: 'We are flying at an _____ of thirty-five thousand feet. The weather ahead looks clear.' You tell your wife what the pilot said.
You are boarding the plane. You check your boarding pass. It says Seat 14A. You know this is a _____ because 'A' is always next to the window on most aircraft.
A flight attendant walks past and says: 'Sir, please fasten your _____ — the captain has turned on the sign.' You look down and click it into place.
Your bag is too large to go under the seat. A flight attendant points upward and says: 'You can put it in the _____ above your seat — there is still some space left.'
The plane starts shaking. The seatbelt sign comes on. The pilot says: 'We are passing through some _____ — please remain seated and keep your seatbelts fastened.'
You want to walk to the bathroom but a person is sleeping in the seat between you and the corridor. You think: 'I should have booked an _____ seat — it would be so much easier.'
The pilot announces: 'Ladies and gentlemen, we are beginning our descent. We expect to complete our _____ in approximately fifteen minutes. Please return to your seats.'
You are checking in at the airport. The agent asks: 'You have a connection in Frankfurt. Your _____ there is three hours — enough time to grab a coffee and relax.'
The plane begins to speed down the runway. You hold your armrest tightly as you feel the wheels leave the ground. Your friend says: 'Relax — _____ is the most exciting part!'
A flight attendant smiles at you and offers a drink. You ask: 'Are you part of the _____ on this flight?' She nods and says: 'Yes, we are here to make your journey comfortable.'
